title: Probationary shadow + swing rollout policy engine
creator: Ava Li
description: Goal: implement a policy engine that supports a two-mode probationary rollout pattern: (1) shadow probation (mirrored traffic with sampling and delayed metrics) and (2) swing steps (gradual traffic transfer with dynamic throttles). This ticket captures the config model, enforcement guardrails, metrics wiring, and a lightweight rollout DSL for product/infra teams to define safe A/B / canary experiments.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Users can declare a rollout with: baseline model, candidate model, shadow percentage, swing schedule (time windows + target step percentages), and rollback thresholds.
2) Platform enforces hard guardrails: latency p95 increase > 25% OR error-rate jump > 3x on candidate triggers automatic halt and rollback.
3) Shadow mode collects per-route diffs and stores per-customer hashed samples for 48h.
4) UI shows live step progress, per-step telemetry (latency, success, token-cost delta).
5) DSL supports windowed traffic slices and 'probe' step that sends small traffic with increased logging to candidate only.
6) End-to-end tests for traffic split math, rollback and shadow capture exist in CI.
design_notes:
- Use existing routing layer hooks to implement soft-shadow (no side-effects) and full-probation shadow (executes candidate but doesn't forward external side-effects).
- Leverage prefix/KV cache policy to avoid cache pollution during shadow.
- Keep policy config small: percent schedule as list of (duration, target_pct), optional probes, and guard thresholds.
- Persist rollout state in control-plane store (existing rollout index), include audit trail of step changes for compliance.
implementation_plan: 1) Schema: add 'probationary_mode' field to rollout spec with values [off, mirror, execute-noncommittal]. 2) Router: implement sampling token and shadow header propagation. 3) Metrics: emit candidate.{metric} and diff.{metric} with request-scoped tags. 4) Safety: implement engine to evaluate guard conditions every minute and escalate to 'paused' or 'rollback' states. 5) Console: minimal UI to create a probationary rollout and view step metrics. 6) Tests: unit + e2e using local runtime harness and synthetic traffic generator.
risk_and_mitigation:
- Risk: shadow executions could cause side-effect leakage. Mitigation: enforce 'noncommittal' runtime mode where mutable connectors are stubbed and external writes are suppressed in candidate path.
- Risk: telemetry lag could cause false-positive rollbacks. Mitigation: require rolling windows (3 datapoints) and exponentially-weighted smoothing before escalation.
- Risk: cache poisoning. Mitigation: segregate KV cache entries with rollout-tagged namespaces.
